heuristics: Table walk on 6-element classes collides at least 94.3% as fast as ideal random draws (Teske 2001; van Oorschot-Wiener 1999)
Cycle rates follow index-coincidence counting with table indices modelled as independent uniform draws (Bos et al. 2010; Bernstein-Lange-Schwabe 2011)
Per-step instruction counts and the per-DP allowance are stated bounds, not measurements
limitations: Memory about 2^76.6 bytes is astronomically large and not realisable.
Per-step canonicalisation cost is a stated instruction bound; a 20 percent error in it moves the score by 0.08.
